capabilities: Create and reorder prev/next note chains with commands and drag-and-drop
Sort and indent File Explorer entries by chain order
Sync note chains with LongForm project scenes
Expose vault tools over a local MCP server and online vault
Automate AI chats in Obsidian Web Viewer
extras: Bundles many loosely related extras beyond chaining: a local MCP/HTTP server, an online vault web interface, an OldBuddy chat UI, WebViewer LLM automation for ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini and others, textarea code blocks, and an EasyAPI scripting layer; README includes a detailed network and privacy disclosure.
motivation: The author was staring at messy drawers of notes and realized 'Linear output requires linear input', so chains should be built from the start.
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer sorts alphabetically or by time and backlink graphs give no linear order, so turning scattered notes into a linear document takes manual effort.

relations.evidence: Reset note chain by longform and Reset longform scenes by note chain are a set of mutually reinforcing commands
Calling a tool runs the matching {name}.md through Templater.

summary: Links notes into ordered chains via prev/next metadata, sorts and indents the File Explorer by chain order, and adds scripting, MCP, and AI-chat tools.
